title: 序章
content_zh:
烈日炎炎，这个夏天似乎比往常的夏天刚更加炎热。大街小巷，人来人往，一片繁忙的景象。天气越来越热，人穿的越来越少，路边，还有成群结队等着看美女的。

霍海，一个本来应该和他们一样的少年，身处于炎炎夏日，心中却是冰凉一片。

“有我这么倒霉的人吗。”霍海自言自语吗，周围的一切，已经完全不关心了。毕业以来的雄心壮志，随着应聘单位的冷言冷语，已经消逝殆尽，剩下的，只有冷漠和疲惫。

每天晚上，内心总是充满了迷茫，不知道自己将来的路在哪里，也不知道自己应该去做什么。每一天，每一刻，霍海感觉自己好像是行尸走肉一样。这样的事情出现在自己的身上，真是老天不公啊。霍海不是怨天尤人的人，却也埋怨了起来。

所谓好人不长命，祸害活千年，记得当初正是因为这样的俗语。霍海的爷爷，才会给霍海起了这样一个名字。谐音祸害，这样才能获得长久，一声大富大贵。

霍海的父亲却和他爷爷不是一种想法，从小对霍海的教导就是，善有善报恶有恶报。这句话，骗了霍海整整二十多年了。当一个好人，哪有那么容易。

回想起当初，自己简直就是路不拾遗，见到老奶奶过马路，自己就去扶着。见到地上有垃圾，自己就去捡起来。大的好事没有机会去做，力所能及的好事，好事，不知道做了多少。这样算起来，自己应该积累了不少阴德了吧，生活应该更好了吧。

当然，到了现在，因为某些原因，老奶奶他是不敢去搀扶了。不过上车的时候给老人让个座之类的，他还是一直都在做。不管是谁，见面都夸霍海是一个好人。

但好人的好报在什么地方，难道自己的遭遇，就是这样的吗。如果仅仅是踏上社会以后，工作难找，也就罢了。这不算什么，谁也不是一开始就能得到他人的赏识。

没有工作，好歹还有一个心理安慰。从高中时期，就一直和自己海誓山盟的女朋友，自己打零工赚到的钱，都用在她身上了。自己有些时候，要吃上好几天的泡面。这样已经很对得起她了吧，自己总不能这个时候，还伸手对家里人要钱吧，他的脸皮还没这么厚。

可是自己都得到了什么。昨天晚上，相处了整整六年的女朋友，提出要和自己分手。

回想起来，到现在，霍海还觉得自己浑身轻飘飘的。“呵呵，我是好人，我们不合适。混蛋，我们不合适，难道你和那个老家伙就合适了。”霍海的心仿佛放进了冰窖一样。

昨天女朋友提出分手，霍海还以为她这是心中又不满意，闹着玩的。今天狠心将剩下的钱全拿了出来，买了一个戒指，打算送给她，讨好她。可是自己都看到了些什么。昨天刚刚分手的女朋友，今天就扑倒了一个可以当她爷爷的老头怀里。

为什么，人家开着跑车来了。自己这样的，就算奋斗一辈子，都别想开上这样的跑车。

别说跑车了，自己的生活，都还没有着落。他能怎么样，他也想和那些主角一样，冲出去狠狠的给那个老家伙几下。可是他真的能这样做吗，他敢这样做吗。

没错，那个老家伙，绝对不是年轻力壮自己的对手，但人家旁边的保镖呢。再说，就算打了怎么办，自己能逃过对方的报复吗。失去的人，还能回来吗。就算回来，自己拿什么来养。要是这个老头报复自己的父母怎么办，他能怎么样呢。

穷人的悲哀啊，这个世界到底都怎么了。霍海不知道，仿佛行尸走肉一样，连出头的想法都没有。就这样行尸走肉一样的走了回来，回到自己租住的小屋当中。

看着手中的戒指，霍海苦笑连连：“下个月的房租怎么办。”戒指买了，难道还能退回去不成。良久之后，霍海从床底下掏出一本老旧的书，翻看了起来。

这是自己奶奶给自己留下的。奶奶好像曾经是苗人，有一手养蛊养虫的绝活。可是随着改革开放发展之后，科学大行其事，自己的父母对这些不科学的东西，根本不相信。只有自己，在小时候，对这些神奇的东西很感兴趣，跟着奶奶学了一段时间。

这上面，记载的正式使用灵气喂养虫子的方式。灵气？这是什么东西，地球上还有吗。用鲜血，霍海小时候怕疼，相信所有小孩子都是一样的。

所以这么多年，霍海也没有养出点什么来，到是这本书上的东西，被霍海记了一个清楚。连带着，一些关于真气运转的穴位和经脉，也都牢牢的记载了脑子里面。

“哎，这些有什么用呢。”霍海无奈的摇着头，脸上的苦涩更加严重。养虫子，能让自己付得起房租吗。别说养不出来，就算真的养出来什么东西，又能怎么样。根据以往对蛊虫的了解，这东西除了能用来害人之外，还有什么用。

现代社会，要害人，还不如一刀一枪有效果。再一次看了一遍，霍海将书放在了桌子上面。

摇了摇牙，到外面买了一扎啤酒，一些小菜，自顾自的吃了起来。“|明天，就回家去，再也不到这个地方来了。”霍海吃下去的是菜，可是咽下去的，都是眼泪。

不知道过了多久，霍海感到一阵阵的头晕，然后趴在桌子上面睡着了。

第二天，阳光洒落，透过窗户，落到了霍海的脸上。一夜宿醉的霍海，缓缓睁开了眼睛。“天亮了，哎，过去的都过去了，还有什么放不下的。回家回家，就算回家去种地，也不来这个地方了。”霍海脸色一阵轻松，苦的都是内心。

离开大城市，说的容易。来到大城市的人，谁愿意离开。别看那些有钱有势的人，整天都在往向下跑。可是需要养家糊口的人，谁也不能放弃大城市带来的收入。

霍海感觉自己与大城市兼职格格不入，当然，更眼中的是女朋友的背叛。在金钱面前，什么都是可以背叛的。不想看到她再次伤心，霍海决定离开这个地方。

收拾了一下东西，实际上也没有什么好收拾的，霍海拉着自己的行李，便离开了自己临时租住的房屋。也不用去找房东了。房东老早就会来收房租，等发现自己离开了，自然会再去租给别人。房东那张让人厌恶的嘴脸，霍海也不想去看了。

最多损失几天的房租而已，老子我还损失的起。远远的，霍海看到一个老大爷正在挥汗如雨的往三轮车上面抗货物。心中本能的一颤，霍海就想上前去帮忙。

可是刚刚迈出去的腿，不自觉的又收了回来。“呵呵，连我自己都帮不了，还去帮别人。难道有好处吗。做了这么多年的好人，到了最后就得到一张好人卡。”

霍海自嘲一番，忍着想要帮忙的想法，转头离开。从本质上说，霍海还是一个没有受到污染的好青年。但好青年，这种生物在这股社会，是无法生存下去的。

因为见到别人需要帮忙没有帮忙，霍海心中十分不好受。毕竟和自己从小受到的教育不同，人生观被自己亲手打碎，不管是谁，心中都会十分难受。神情恍惚的霍海，丝毫没有发现，前面的绿灯已经变成了红色。依旧一脸恍惚的往前面走着。

“吱……”尖锐的刹车声忽然在耳边响起，霍海茫然的抬起头。忽然身体一疼，整个人好像腾云驾雾一般，居然飞起来了。恍惚的霍海，终于反应了过来。

“我，我这是被撞飞了。”车祸的字眼出现在了霍海的心中。临死之际，霍海没有想到其他，而是想到自己从前，从前所做过的一件一件的好事。不管大小，以前做过的好事，在自己的脑海当中划过。没想到，自己记忆最深刻的，居然是这些。

因为自己的善良，拥有了别人都羡慕的女朋友，也因为自己的善良，将所有机会让给其他人。到了现在，他还连工作都成问题。最后的下场，居然是这样。

不知道父母知道了，会不会伤心死。霍海心中，闪过父母的面庞。然后是奶奶，接着是爷爷。“小海，你要像你的名字一样，永远好好的活下去。”

爷爷慈祥的面庞，在自己的面前划过。“对，没错，我的名字，我是霍海。我霍海对天发誓，如果还有来世，我一定对得起我的名字。好人不长命，祸害活千年。老子发誓，我再也不做好人了。”霍海带着愤怒，将自己最后一口气化为自己的誓言。

之后，身体好像撞在什么东西上一样，眼前一黑，什么都不知道了。
content_en:
The sun is scorching, and this summer seems to be hotter than usual.The streets and alleys are busy with people coming and going.The weather is getting hotter and hotter, people wear less and less, and there are groups of people waiting to see beautiful women on the roadside.

Huo Hai, a young man who should have been just like them, was in the hot summer, but his heart felt cold.

"Is there anyone as unlucky as me?" Huo Hai said to himself. He no longer cared about everything around him.The ambitions I had had since graduation have completely disappeared along with the sarcastic remarks from the employers I applied for, leaving only indifference and exhaustion.

Every night, my heart is always full of confusion. I don't know where my future path is, and I don't know what I should do.Every day, every moment, Huo Hai feels like a zombie.It's really unfair that such a thing happened to me.Huo Hai was not a blaming person, but he also complained.

As the saying goes, good people don't live long and evil people live for thousands of years. I remember it was because of this saying.Huo Hai's grandfather gave Huo Hai such a name.Homophones for disaster, only in this way can we gain long-term prosperity and great wealth.

Huo Hai's father had different ideas from his grandfather. Huo Hai was taught that good will be rewarded with good and evil will be punished with evil.This sentence has deceived Huo Hai for more than 20 years.Being a good person is never that easy.

Looking back at the beginning, I simply didn't pick up things on the road. When I saw an old lady crossing the road, I helped her.When you see rubbish on the ground, pick it up yourself.I don’t have the opportunity to do big good deeds. I don’t know how many good deeds and good deeds I can do.Calculating it this way, I should have accumulated a lot of yin virtues, and my life should be better.

Of course, now, for some reasons, he no longer dares to help the old lady.However, he still always offers his seat to the elderly when getting on the bus.No matter who it is, everyone praises Huo Hai as a good person when they meet.

But where are the good rewards for good people? Is this what happened to me?If it's just that it's hard to find a job after entering society, that's it.This is nothing, no one can be appreciated by others at the beginning.

There is no job, but at least there is psychological comfort.He has been with his girlfriend since high school and spent all the money he earned from doing part-time jobs on her.Sometimes I have to eat instant noodles for several days.This is already very worthy of her. He can't ask his family for money at this time. He is not so thick-skinned.

But what did he get?Last night, my girlfriend of six years proposed to break up with me.

Looking back, Huo Hai still feels light all over."Haha, I'm a good person, but we're not suitable. Asshole, we're not suitable. How could you and that old guy be suitable?" Huo Hai's heart felt as if it had been put into an ice cellar.

Yesterday, his girlfriend proposed breaking up, and Huo Hai thought she was just joking because she was dissatisfied.Today, Cruel took out all the remaining money and bought a ring, intending to give it to her to please her.But he saw something.The girlfriend who just broke up with her yesterday fell into the arms of an old man who could be her grandfather today.

Why, they came in a sports car.If you are like me, even if you work hard all your life, you will never be able to drive such a sports car.

Let alone a sports car, my life is not settled yet.What can he do? He also wants to be like the protagonists, rush out and give the old guy a few hard blows.But can he really do this? Does he dare to do this?

Yes, that old guy is definitely no match for his young and strong self, but what about the bodyguard next to him?Besides, what if I get beaten? Can I escape the other party's revenge?Can the lost person come back?Even if you come back, what will you use to support yourself?What if this old man takes revenge on his parents? What can he do?

The sorrow of the poor, what is happening to this world.Huo Hai didn't know, he was like a walking zombie, he didn't even have the idea to come forward.He just walked back like a zombie and returned to the small house he rented.

Looking at the ring in his hand, Huo Hai smiled bitterly: "What about next month's rent?" I bought the ring, can I still return it?After a long time, Huo Hai took out an old book from under the bed and started reading.

This is what my grandma left for me.It seems that grandma was once a Miao person and had a unique skill in raising poisonous insects.However, with the development of reform and opening up, science became popular, and my parents did not believe in these unscientific things at all.Only I, when I was a child, was very interested in these magical things and studied them with my grandma for a while.

Here, the official method of using spiritual energy to feed insects is recorded.Reiki?What is this? Is there anything else on earth?With blood, Huo Hai was afraid of pain when he was a child. I believe all children are the same.

Therefore, Huo Hai has not cultivated anything for so many years, but Huo Hai has clearly recorded the things in this book.At the same time, some acupuncture points and meridians related to the circulation of Qi are also firmly recorded in my mind.

"Hey, what's the use of these?" Huo Hai shook his head helplessly, the bitterness on his face getting worse.Can you afford to pay the rent by raising insects?Don't say you can't raise it, even if you do raise something, so what.Based on my past understanding of Gu insects, apart from being used to harm people, what other uses does this thing have?

In modern society, killing people is not as effective as a knife or a gun.After reading it again, Huo Hai placed the book on the table.

Shaking his teeth, he went outside to buy a beer and some side dishes, and ate on his own."|Tomorrow, I will go home and never come to this place again." What Huo Hai ate was food, but what he swallowed were tears.

I don't know how long it took, but Huo Hai felt dizzy and fell asleep on the table.

The next day, the sun shone through the window and fell on Huo Hai's face.Huo Hai, who had been hungover all night, slowly opened his eyes."It's dawn. Hey, the past has passed. There's nothing left to let go of. Go home, go home, even if you go home to farm, you won't come to this place anymore." Huo Hai's face relaxed for a while, but the pain was all in his heart.

Leaving the big city is easier said than done.No one who comes to a big city wants to leave.Don't look at those rich and powerful people who are running down all day long.But no one who needs to support their families can give up the income brought by big cities.

Huo Hai feels that he is out of tune with his part-time job in the big city. Of course, he is more concerned about his girlfriend's betrayal.In the face of money, everything can be betrayed.Not wanting to see her sad again, Huo Hai decided to leave this place.

After packing his things, there was actually nothing to pack. Huo Hai took his luggage and left his temporary rented house.There is no need to go to the landlord.The landlord will come to collect the rent a long time ago. When he finds out that he has left, he will naturally rent to others.Huo Hai didn't want to look at the landlord's disgusting face.

It’s just a few days’ worth of rent lost at most, I can’t afford the loss.From a distance, Huo Hai saw an old man sweating profusely while loading cargo onto a tricycle.With an instinctive tremor in his heart, Huo Hai wanted to step forward to help.

But the leg that he just stepped out unconsciously took it back again."Haha, I can't even help myself, so I help others. Is there any benefit? After being a good person for so many years, I get a good person card at the end."

Huo Hai laughed at himself, resisted the thought of helping, and turned around to leave.In essence, Huo Hai is still a good young man who is not contaminated.But good young people, such creatures cannot survive in this society.

Huo Hai felt very uncomfortable because he didn't help others when he saw them in need.After all, it was different from the education he had received since childhood. If his outlook on life was shattered by his own hands, no matter who he was, he would feel very uncomfortable.Huo Hai, who was in a daze, did not notice at all that the green light in front had turned red.Still walking forward with a dazed look on his face.

"Squeak..." The sharp sound of brakes suddenly sounded in his ears, and Huo Hai raised his head blankly.Suddenly, my body hurt, and my whole body seemed to be flying in the clouds.Huo Hai, who was in a daze, finally reacted.

"I, I was knocked away." The word car accident appeared in Huo Hai's mind.When he was dying, Huo Hai didn't think about anything else, but thought about the good things he had done in the past.No matter how big or small, the good deeds you have done in the past flash through your mind.Unexpectedly, these are the things that I remember most deeply.

Because of his kindness, he has a girlfriend that others envy, and because of his kindness, he gives up all opportunities to others.Now, he still has trouble finding work.The final outcome was actually like this.

I wonder if my parents would be heartbroken if they found out.In Huo Hai's heart, the faces of his parents flashed across his mind.Then grandma, then grandpa."Xiao Hai, you have to live a good life forever, just like your name."

Grandpa's kind face flashed in front of him."Yes, that's right, my name is Huo Hai. I, Huo Hai, swear to God that if there is another life, I will be worthy of my name. Good people don't live long, and disasters live for thousands of years. I swear, I will never be a good person again." With anger, Huo Hai turned his last breath into his own oath.

After that, his body seemed to have hit something, his vision went dark, and he didn't know anything anymore.
